high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account of Sachin Tendulkar (@sachin_rt). The tweet was posted 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 11:50 AM, as indicated by the status bar at the top of the screen. The battery level is at 13%. The tweet is in both Hindi and English and celebrates Neeraj Chopra's performance in the javelin throw event at the Tokyo Olympics 2020. The Hindi text reads: "नीरज ने जैवेलिन को पह
